items.description: The main royal palace of the Joseon dynasty, originally built in 1395. It served as the center of royal power and was destroyed multiple times throughout history.
A former prison used during the Japanese colonial rule to hold Korean independence activists. It now serves as a memorial museum documenting the independence struggle.
A sprawling palace complex featuring traditional Joseon architecture and expansive gardens. It remains one of the most recognizable cultural landmarks in South Korea.
